name: Virus
effect: On play: deal 1 damage to opponent HP
tooltip: A virus is malicious code that spreads by attaching itself to other programs

name: Worm
effect: On play: summon one 1/1 Worm Token
tooltip: A worm spreads across networks on its own without needing a host file

name: Trojan Horse
effect: On play: draw 1 card
tooltip: A trojan disguises itself as safe software to trick users into installing it

name: Ransomware
effect: On attack: the damaged Agent cannot attack next turn
tooltip: Ransomware locks a victim's files and demands payment to restore access

name: Keylogger
effect: On play: reveal 1 random card from opponent hand
tooltip: A keylogger secretly records everything a user types to steal passwords

name: Spyware
effect: On play: reveal opponent full hand
tooltip: Spyware silently collects user data and sends it to the attacker

name: Rootkit
effect: Cannot be targeted by Exploits
tooltip: A rootkit hides deep in a system giving attackers long-term hidden access

name: Botnet Node
effect: On play: summon two 1/1 Botnet Tokens
tooltip: A botnet is a network of infected computers controlled by one attacker

name: Logic Bomb
effect: When destroyed: deal 2 damage to opponent HP
tooltip: A logic bomb is hidden code that triggers a harmful action when a condition is met

name: Fileless Malware
effect: Cannot be targeted by Protocols
tooltip: Fileless malware runs in memory only making it very hard to detect

name: Polymorphic Virus
effect: Gains +1 ATK each turn it survives
tooltip: Polymorphic viruses change their code constantly to avoid detection

name: Cryptojacker
effect: On play: opponent loses 1 Energy this turn
tooltip: Cryptojacking secretly uses a victim's device to mine cryptocurrency

name: Backdoor
effect: Can attack opponent HP directly ignoring Taunt

name: APT
effect: Taunt. Restores 1 HP to itself each turn
tooltip: An APT is a long-term stealthy attack where attackers stay hidden for months

name: Brute Force Bot
effect: Gains +1 ATK after each attack whether it destroys a target or not
tooltip: Brute force attacks try every possible password until one works

name: Man-in-the-Middle
effect: On play: cancel the last Exploit played this turn

name: Scareware
effect: On play: opponent discards 1 random card
tooltip: Scareware uses fake warnings to frighten users into harmful actions

name: Dropper
effect: On play: summon 1 random VOID Agent from your discard pile

name: Zombie Node
effect: Taunt. When destroyed: deal 1 damage to the attacker
tooltip: A zombie is an infected machine silently following attacker commands

name: Adware
effect: On play: deal 1 damage to opponent HP

name: Buffer Overflow
effect: Destroy one Agent with 3 HP or less

name: SQL Injection
effect: Destroy 1 random card in opponent hand

name: Zero-Day
effect: Destroy any one Agent on the board

name: Phishing Attack
effect: Steal 1 random card from opponent hand
tooltip: Phishing tricks users into giving up passwords through fake emails or websites

name: Session Hijacking
effect: Opponent skips their next draw phase

name: Privilege Escalation
effect: Give one friendly Agent +2 ATK this turn

name: DDoS Strike
effect: Deal 1 damage to all enemy Agents

effect: Take control of one enemy Agent for 1 turn

name: Credential Dump

name: Lateral Movement
effect: Give one friendly Agent an extra attack this turn

effect: Redirect one opponent Exploit to their own board

effect: Cancel one opponent Exploit before it resolves

name: Wiper
effect: Destroy all Agents on both sides of the board

name: Obfuscation
effect: One friendly Agent cannot be targeted this turn

name: Antivirus Engine

effect: Draw 1 card whenever any Agent is destroyed

name: Zero Trust Agent
effect: Cannot be affected by any card effects from either side

name: Penetration Test
effect: Deal 2 damage to all enemy Agents
